# testing_x_param_sensitive (Resource)

XParamSensitive Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_param_sensitive" "my_xparamsensitive" {
  string_request              = "...my_string_request..."
  string_request_and_response = "...my_string_request_and_response..."
  string_response             = "...my_string_response..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `string_request` (String, Sensitive) string request only x-speakeasy-param-sensitive (true)
- `string_request_and_response` (String, Sensitive) string request and response x-speakeasy-param-sensitive (true)
- `string_response` (String, Sensitive) string response only x-speakeasy-param-sensitive (true)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_param_sensitive.my_testing_x_param_sensitive
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_param_sensitive.my_testing_x_param_sensitive "..."
```
